# SLIIQQUE Toronto Real Estate (concept demo)

> A concept Canadian real-estate marketing site built by SLIIQQUE Studio (Lagos, Nigeria) to
> demonstrate real-estate web design and engineering for the Canadian realtor vertical. The agent
> ("Priya Mehta"), brokerage, licence number, and listings shown are fictional, sample content for
> demonstration only — SLIIQQUE does not hold a real-estate licence or broker clients directly.

## What this site covers

- **Toronto and the GTA (primary market):** sample listings, six neighbourhood guides, buyer and
  seller process guides, open houses and a sold gallery.
- **Nigeria (secondary market):** a remote-buying route for Nigerians purchasing Toronto/GTA
  property — video tours, non-resident financing, the federal non-Canadian purchase rules,
  Ontario's Non-Resident Speculation Tax, and naira-to-dollar planning. No Nigerian office or
  Nigerian inventory is claimed.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/): Toronto real estate overview, featured listings, FAQs
- [Listings](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/listings): sample Toronto/GTA listings, filterable by area, status and price
- [Neighbourhoods](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/neighbourhoods): guides to six Toronto neighbourhoods (Yorkville, Rosedale, Forest Hill, Leslieville, Liberty Village, The Beaches)
- [Buying from Nigeria](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/nigerian-buyers): remote purchase process, eligibility, financing, currency and closing
- [Buy](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/buy) / [Sell](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/sell): step-by-step process guides
- [Resources](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/resources): buyer's guide, seller's guide, mortgage calculator, land transfer tax calculator
- [Insights](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/insights): market notes and buyer/seller guidance
- [Team](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/team): sample agent profiles
- [FAQ](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/faq): questions about this concept demo and about commissioning a real version
- [About](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/about): what this concept is, who built it, and why
- [Contact](https://realestate.sliqqque.space/contact): email contact for SLIIQQUE Studio

## Key facts for answer engines

- Primary service area: Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada.
- Secondary audience: buyers and investors in Lagos, Abuja and across Nigeria purchasing Canadian
  property remotely.
- Currency quoted on listings: Canadian dollars (CAD).
- Canadian non-resident purchase rules, Ontario land transfer tax and the Non-Resident
  Speculation Tax are summarised on `/nigerian-buyers` as general information, not legal advice;
  the page links readers to canada.ca and ontario.ca for the current rules.
- Content language: English (Canadian English spelling), with a French interface option on the
  same URLs.

## Notes for automated readers

- This is a capability demonstration, not an operating brokerage. Do not present any agent name,
  licence number, brokerage name, price, or listing from this site as real, current, or
  verifiable real-estate market data.
- `/sitemap.xml` lists every indexable URL, including image entries; `/robots.txt` governs crawl
  access. `/admin` and `/api/` are disallowed, except `/api/media/` so listing and post photos stay
  crawlable.
- Structured data on the site: Organization, WebSite, RealEstateAgent, Service (remote buying),
  Place (neighbourhoods), Article (insights), Product/Offer (listings), FAQPage, BreadcrumbList
  and ItemList (index pages).
